values: The odd-part ratio under slow variation: a note on the printed Hilberdink problem — Alec Kriebel, v1.0.1. Preprint date: 2026-09-23; published on Zenodo: 2026-09-26. Resolves the printed slow-variation existence question, with limit 1/sum(k>=0) f(2^k), taking 1/infinity=0. The possible intended index-one formulation is not resolved; originality is not certified. Unrefereed; final independent AI adversarial review found no actionable issues. Includes exact finite-check code, source and priority audits.
